created_at_utc_note: created after the C objective rewrite (v2); no back-filled timestamps

cohort_identity.observation_unit: chromosome (20 correlated measurements of one cell; not biological replicates)

baseline.second_1Mb_extension: not used; the user explicitly cancelled the extra 486FG second segment

extra-levels.start: same 014 unlabeled random structure origin (seed 2207); 20Mb and 10Mb are freshly expanded full grids; the 5Mb start is the prolongation of A's own 10Mb endpoint (A's C branch is therefore not the same start as baseline) and 2Mb/1Mb are prolongations of A's previous layer
extra-levels.note: not an equal-cost comparison; the new coarse layers are deliberately cheap

no-bend.start: same frozen 5Mb start as baseline; rerun from the start, not bend-off at the endpoint

reference-beads.support: per-copy bead presence mask from reference tracks; missing copy bead truly exits count kernel/bond/bend/repulsion; locus union retained; gene indices/intervals not compressed
reference-beads.support_source_authorized: reference chr/position/presence only; reference xyz values never used for initialization, target, or regularization
reference-beads.exposure: production e on the filtered data: endpoint counts from the eligible pairs (both endpoints in lane) plus 2*diag on lane, sqrt(endpoint+10), normalized to mean one over lane, zero outside lane; not the full-data e

evaluation.support: 046 frozen legacy 21-mask snapshot (2447 valid loci, 157529 intra pairs); C 1Mb support contains all of them (inputs/legacy_mask_containment.json), so the denominator is neither expanded nor shrunk
evaluation.index_mapping: global = offset + position // 1Mb using the real numeric position; no compressed index used as a genomic bin
evaluation.metric: per-chromosome signed Pearson of intra-chromosomal distance vectors; whole-chromosome best A/B swap (not per-bin relabeling); same = matched, cross = swapped; two copies averaged
evaluation.undefined_values: NA, never 0; chromosomes with NA are not dropped from the tables
evaluation.figure_scale_rule: one optimal positive scale per condition on chr1, applied to both copies of that condition; reference scale fixed at 1; uniform scaling does not change Pearson
evaluation.denominator: shared support = frozen legacy 21-mask common pairs; all four conditions and the reference share the same 157529 intra pairs, dropped = 0; C's 1Mb support covers every legacy common pair so the denominator is neither expanded nor shrunk
evaluation.units_note: legacy mask positions are base pairs (all multiples of 1Mb)

figure_style.figure1: chr1 distance matrices, reference mat/pat + 4 conditions x 2 copies (2 rows x 5 columns)
figure_style.figure2: same/cross Pearson boxplot with 20 chromosome points

v1.reason: first masked_objective used coordinate zeroing plus denominator rescaling; scientifically incorrect, not delivered

v2_intersection.reason: second C version filtered pairs by the two-copy intersection, which deletes contacts of single-sided loci; violated the frozen lane-union rule, results void

revision_note: only the invalid/fixed entries below were revised; created_at_utc is the original first write time and is not back-filled

1Mb.note: counts from np.count_nonzero on the support mask

reference_beads.export_rule: 3DG writes only real beads at their original bp (1Mb = 4947 rows, identical to the reference finite set); NPZ keeps the full grid with NaN at missing beads
